name: Rayami, First of the Fallen
description: A vampire bloodchief from Zendikar created by Ulamog, driven by bloodlust and Eldrazi madness.

timeline.summary: Twelve cultists survive and become the first vampire bloodchiefs, enslaved to Ulamog.
timeline.quote: those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire race

timeline.summary: After the Eldrazi's defeat only Drana is said to survive among the bloodchiefs, so Rayami must be dead.
timeline.quote: Drana was said to be the only surviving bloodchief, so Rayami must now be dead.
